text.p: Sealed bids for the purchase of $205,000,000 General Obligation Highway Bonds, Series 1997F (the Bonds'') of the State of Utah (the State'') will be received up to 10:30 A.M., M.D.T., on
at the offices of the Utah State Treasurer, at 215 State Capitol Building, in Salt Lake City, Utah 84114.
The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997, and will mature serially on July 1 of each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:

Interest will be payable semiannually on January 1 and July 1 in each year, commencing on January 1, 1998, at a rate or rates per annum, not exceeding five and fifty- hundredths percent (5.50%) per annum to be fixed at the time the Bonds are sold. The Bonds will be issued in registered form, and, when issued, will be registered in the name of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, or its nominee. The Depository Trust Company will act as securities depository for the Bonds. Purchases of beneficial interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form only in the denomination of $5,000 or any whole multiple thereof. The Bonds are being offered subject to the approval of legality by Chapman and Cutler, Bond Counsel, and certain other conditions.

Copies of the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE, the OFFICIAL STATEMENT, bid forms and other related information with respect to the Bonds, may be obtained from the State's Financial Advisor, Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111-2336, telephone (801) 524-2100, facsimile transmission (801) 524- 2109 or from the undersigned Utah State Treasurer at his office, 215 State Capitol Building, Salt Lake City, Utah 84114, telephone (801) 538-1042, facsimile transmission (801) 538-1465.
